source: User CoNuExistentialism+ and CoG_dSide+ naming proposal, 2026-11-10
principle: Generate candidate vocabulary liberally but qualify conservatively: meaning, anti-meaning, relations, test, owner/receiver and supersession paths.
lexical_guardrails: No assertion of divine origin or authority
Do not infer real-world substrate equivalence
Avoid synonym proliferation: dedupe candidate terms before promoting
Give plain-language UX and progressive disclosure
Record dissent, inversions and retirement states
